hints.title: Single Occurrence Contribution
hints.text: Calculate how many substrings contain a given character occurrence as its sole instance.

hints.title: Adjacent Same-Character Boundaries
hints.text: For character at index i, locate its previous occurrence index prev and next occurrence index nxt.

hints.title: Subarray Multiplicative Combinatorics
hints.text: The character at index i is unique in all substrings whose start lies in (prev, i] and whose end lies in [i, nxt). Add (i - prev) * (nxt - i) to the total.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Records character positions and evaluates contribution formula per occurrence.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating uniqueness across all O(N^2) substrings takes O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: List of indices per character requires O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Invert the problem from counting unique letters per substring to counting substrings per character.
